text:
alex.sales: Heads-up — Luminar just returned our RFP with a lot of redlines on SLA + KMS. They want an explicit playbook for key management and a clause for regional data egress. Can SEs + Security weigh in?

priya.se: I can take the KMS section. Quick Q: do they require HSM-backed keys or will KMS with BYOK suffice?

jordan.security: Their questionnaire calls out FIPS 140-2/3 and HSM for master keys. We should confirm whether Redwood Private (on-prem) or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS is acceptable.

marta.solutions: For POC scope: Luminar needs a 4-week POC with ingestion of 50k docs, embeddings, and a latency SLA for 95th pct < 300ms. That's likely Dedicated capacity. Need pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted for that throughput.

alex.sales: @marta noted pricing. Samir, can you ballpark the Dedicated monthly commit for that load? We may need a staged topology: hosted for dev, dedicated for POC.

samir.eng: ballpark: for 50k docs and sustained inferencing I'd recommend 2x A100-equivalent nodes reserved; estimate ~$45k/mo committed, plus egress. I'll pull numbers from the cost model.

priya.se: Re: KMS, if they insist on HSM we can offer Private with HSM integration or Dedicated + external HSM via partner. Need legal to sign off on SLA+HSM appendix.

jordan.security: Also call out auditing — we must provide access to KMS audit logs and key usage events. Add requirement: customer-managed CMKs, rotation policy, and export restrictions.

alex.sales: Luminar also flagged a clause that we can't disclose model weights or vector indexes. They want a clause for data residency in eu-west-1 only. Is that covered?

marta.solutions: Yes, Dedicated can pin region to eu-west-1. For Hosted API we'd need enterprise agreement and dedicated tenancy. I'll note that in the capability matrix.

priya.se: I'll draft a KMS playbook snippet we can attach to the RFP response. Prototype text:```KMS Playbook:
- Option A: Private (on-prem) with customer HSM (FIPS 140-2/3)
- Option B: Dedicated with BYOK and external HSM integration via partner
- Audit: Key usage logs forwarded to customer's SIEM via secure syslog
- Rotation: customer-controlled rotation policy, RFC-based change windows```

alex.sales: Perfect. Can someone attach the latest capability matrix and the POC SOW template? Luminar asked for both as separate attachments.

marta.solutions: Attached `capability_matrix_v3.xlsx` and `poc_sow_template_Luminar.docx` — links: https://drive.redwood/example/cap_matrix_v3 and https://drive.redwood/example/poc_sow_Luminar

samir.eng: Adding a note on blockers: network peering for their VPC, egress controls, and latency tests require our peering checklist. I'll add the `peering-checklist.md` snippet to the response package.

jordan.security: Also flag: legal wants to avoid unlimited liability on data loss; recommend limiting SLA credits and adding remediation steps (hot standby, fallback to smaller model) in case of infra failure.

priya.se: I'll drop a short FAQ for the RFP: `Does Redwood support HSM?` -> "Yes: Private on-prem with HSM, or Dedicated with partner HSM integration; full audit logs available."

alex.sales: Thanks team. Action items: Priya — draft KMS playbook + FAQ (today EOD). Marta — finalize capability matrix + attach SOW (tomorrow AM). Samir — cost estimate for Dedicated POC + peering checklist (tomorrow AM). Jordan — legal/security bullets for RFP (tomorrow AM). I'll prepare a short covering email to attach the bundle. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: New file uploaded by marta.solutions: `capability_matrix_v3.xlsx` (size 320KB)

alex.sales: Filing this as the main thread for Luminar RFP. If anyone needs to escalate to Legal, ping me and I'll loop them in.

marta.solutions: One more thing — Luminar asked about quantization and embedding vector retention. I'll add a short blurb: "We support quantized model variants for cost savings; vector retention configurable per-tenant and purged on request."

priya.se: Draft KMS playbook uploaded: https://drive.redwood/example/kms_playbook_luminar.md

samir.eng: Cost doc added: https://drive.redwood/example/luminar_dedicated_cost_estimate.pdf

alex.sales: Great — closing the loop. I'll send the packet after Priya's final KMS text.
